walkthroughs.body_html:
Food Preparation Skills — a core area of GCSE Food Preparation and Nutrition.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Food Preparation Skills brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Food Preparation Skills.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What are the 4 Cs of food hygiene?
options: Chopping, Cleaning, Cooling, Carrying.
Calories, Carbs, Calcium, Cholesterol.
